tabData.title: Commit to the Future: How GitHub and Copilot Are Changing the Way We Work
tabData.text:
Version control isn’t just for code anymore. From open source to AI-assisted creativity, GitHub and Copilot are redefining how we collaborate, learn, and build. This session explores how human insight and machine intelligence can merge to accelerate innovation — and what that means for everyone, not just developers.

This session will introduce the cloud features, highlight key differences from the old setup, and give you a sneak peek at Rovo—Atlassian’s new AI assistant that’s set to change the way we find, create, and collaborate.

tabData.title: From Pets to Cattle to Ghosts: The Evolution of Containers
tabData.text:
Infrastructure has evolved—from lovingly maintained servers (“pets”) to disposable VMs and orchestrated clusters (“cattle”). Now, serverless containers introduce “ghosts”: ephemeral workloads that appear when needed and vanish when idle, cutting waste and energy use. This talk explores why this shift matters for speed, cost, carbon, and resilience, and how it reshapes how we build and run applications—with insights on right-sizing, smart scheduling, and carbon-aware design. 
 Critical Skill : **Sustainable Technology**

tabData.title: GitHub Copilot at LBG - Now and Next (Microsoft)
tabData.text:

Come to this session to step through a journey where GitHub Copilot can help accelerate your development activities by using AI. Get hands-on with the technology and learn some tips & tricks. tabData.title: Building and Deploying Apps with Backstage and Harness
tabData.text:
Join us for an immersive hands-on technical workshop where we will guide you through the process of creating an app using Backstage and Harness, providing a comprehensive engineer's experience from start to finish. We will provide you with all the necessary access and resources, along with step-by-step guidelines. Our experts will be on hand to assist and answer any questions you may have, ensuring you gain practical, hands-on experience. Don't miss this opportunity to enhance your skills, learn from industry experts, and collaborate with fellow engineers.

tabData.title: Customer Value Proposition - putting your customer needs first
tabData.text:
The Customer Value Proposition (CVP) is a design framework that helps us create market-leading products and build deeper relationships with our customers. It models the relationship between customer segments and value propositions found in the product and is an effective tool for creating experience-led brands that grow value and enable delivery of our strategy. This workshop will give you the theory behind the CVP before allowing you to create one in a small team.  
 Critical Skill : **Proposition Design**
tabData.name: Kat Walker

tabData.title: Discovering value through Customer Centricity
tabData.text:
In this workshop you'll explore powerful tools like the Product Canvas and Customer Journey Map and use Design Thinking techniques to understand how we can all better understand the pains, gains and jobs of our customers. Through hands-on activities, you'll use the tools to build a backlog of value aligned to the needs of our customer. This workshop is designed to help us all think differently about how we discover value, ensuring our products continuously improve the experience of customers.  
 Critical Skill : **Customer Centricity**
